about: Timeline path 3 of 3, 'Who is answering' (docs/research/2026-10-01-timeline-brainstorm.md): the book as the other side of a test, Jung 1949 to today. Opens on all three paths (series/explainers/timeline-paths.json) and flies down this one. Draft 1, with Astra (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-timeline-paths.md).
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

BINARY, CORRESPONDENCE,
AND WHO IS ANSWERING.

PASS FOR A PERSON?

READ IT WELL?
